purpose: Predict successful adjustment after move to senior living

signals.why_it_matters: Nearness increases visit consistency and emotional continuity.
signals.how_measured: Miles between reference family location and community.

signals.why_it_matters: More frequent visits usually improve adjustment and retention.
signals.how_measured: Self-reported expected visits per week or month.

signals.why_it_matters: Long travel burden reduces real visit follow-through.
signals.how_measured: Median drive time from family to community.

signals.why_it_matters: High involvement predicts better advocacy and transition support.
signals.how_measured: Structured intake scale (low, medium, high).

signals.why_it_matters: Communication barriers can slow trust and care quality.
signals.how_measured: Match ratio between resident language needs and community support.

signals.why_it_matters: Faith alignment can improve comfort and belonging.
signals.how_measured: Binary and degree-of-fit match to stated preferences.

signals.why_it_matters: Cultural fit affects adaptation, social confidence, and satisfaction.
signals.how_measured: Qualitative fit index from profile matching.

signals.why_it_matters: Size mismatch can reduce comfort and social integration.
signals.how_measured: Difference between preferred and actual resident size band.

signals.why_it_matters: Lifestyle mismatch can affect satisfaction and perceived value.
signals.how_measured: Amenity tier match against family preference.

signals.why_it_matters: Introvert or extrovert fit affects daily wellbeing and participation.
signals.how_measured: Fit score from activity intensity and resident style preferences.

signals.why_it_matters: High quality activities improve adjustment and reduce isolation risk.
signals.how_measured: Theme extraction on activity experience quality mentions.

signals.why_it_matters: Diverse programming supports broader engagement and sustained interest.
signals.how_measured: Count of distinct activity categories per month.

signals.why_it_matters: High engagement correlates with stronger social adaptation.
signals.how_measured: Mention trends for belonging and interaction.

signals.why_it_matters: Positive satisfaction signal is a leading indicator of adjustment.
signals.how_measured: Positive minus negative satisfaction mention balance.

signals.why_it_matters: Early loneliness risk predicts failed transitions and move-outs.
signals.how_measured: Recurring loneliness language pattern detection.

signals.why_it_matters: Warmth strongly affects trust and emotional security.
signals.how_measured: Recurring warmth signal extraction with minimum mention threshold.

signals.why_it_matters: Responsiveness predicts issue resolution and family confidence.
signals.how_measured: Recurring response-time and follow-through mention extraction.

signals.why_it_matters: Continuity improves relationship stability and care consistency.
signals.how_measured: Staff continuity proxy from tenure and turnover indicators.

signals.why_it_matters: High turnover is associated with instability and lower care consistency.
signals.how_measured: Trend in turnover and departure mentions over time.

signals.why_it_matters: Staff morale influences resident interactions and service quality.
signals.how_measured: Aggregated employee sentiment trend score.

signals.why_it_matters: Broad safety and quality benchmark tied to outcomes.
signals.how_measured: Latest overall CMS rating.

signals.why_it_matters: Staffing quality predicts care responsiveness and safety outcomes.
signals.how_measured: Latest CMS staffing rating and trend.

signals.why_it_matters: Inspection performance captures compliance and risk signals.
signals.how_measured: Latest CMS inspection rating and trend.

signals.why_it_matters: Deficiency severity and recurrence indicate operational risk.
signals.how_measured: Count and severity of deficiencies in rolling windows.

signals.why_it_matters: Monetary penalties indicate confirmed compliance failures.
signals.how_measured: Fine count and severity in rolling windows.

signals.why_it_matters: Frequent ownership changes can disrupt operations and culture.
signals.how_measured: Ownership change events in last 12 months.

signals.why_it_matters: Leadership continuity supports stable operations and resident trust.
signals.how_measured: Tenure length in months and change events.

signals.why_it_matters: Clinical leadership stability predicts care consistency.
signals.how_measured: Tenure length in months and change events.

signals.why_it_matters: Worsening turnover trend signals rising disruption risk.
signals.how_measured: 90-day and 180-day trend slope on turnover signals.

signals.why_it_matters: Dining quality is a top driver of day-to-day satisfaction.
signals.how_measured: Recurring food sentiment signal extraction.

signals.why_it_matters: Access to outdoor areas supports wellbeing and social interaction.
signals.how_measured: Presence and quality indicators from photos and descriptions.

signals.why_it_matters: Reliable transport affects independence and appointment adherence.
signals.how_measured: Transportation availability, schedule breadth, and satisfaction mentions.

signals.why_it_matters: Flexible dining options improve autonomy and quality of life.
signals.how_measured: Availability of choice windows, menu flexibility, accommodation mentions.

signals.why_it_matters: Room quality influences comfort and long-term retention.
signals.how_measured: Recurring room condition and comfort mentions.

signals.why_it_matters: Wellness support improves functional outcomes and satisfaction.
signals.how_measured: Presence and breadth of wellness program categories.
